title: Lost-landing evidence must reach the committed dossier — re-filed after the cycle-1546 salvage excised the draft (coupled to the landing-witness redesign)
summary: Re-filed 2026-08-23. finalizeCycle stamps the landing-lost SystemFailureSignal onto CycleResult, but writeCycleDossier receives only the terminal outcome string, so the durable record loses the category and evidence — an operator reading knowledge-base/cycles/cycle-N.json cannot see WHY a cycle was downgraded. The cycle-1546 draft (dossier/* changes, dossier_producer signature change threading SystemFailure through, schema extension) was excised with the witness draft because the two land as one surface and the witness half carried HIGH defects.
fix: Re-land the dossier half from the preserved draft (branch cycle-42824668-1546, snapshot b9118b55febd235aa6367bf1de62ce2ae45b9b13: internal/dossier/landing_lost.go, dossier_producer* signature change, schemas/cycle-dossier.schema.json), WITH acs/cycle1544 predicates 004-005 restored (evidence reaches the committed dossier; landed sibling carries none; ordinary PASS stays byte-clean). May land before or with the witness redesign — the signal it records is produced by the EXISTING floor (PR #482), so it is not blocked on the witness; only the excision was coupled.
acceptance: A landing-lost cycle's committed dossier carries the signal's structured category AND evidence text, driven through the REAL writeCycleDossier path.
A landed sibling with the same transient ship error carries no landing-lost evidence; an ordinary PASS dossier stays byte-clean.
notes: Continuation binding released 2026-08-23 with no item file to carry the salvage pointer — THIS file is that pointer.
